title: The $k$-out-of-$n$ picture-hanging puzzle: shorter solutions for small $k$ and $n-k$
summary: The picture-hanging puzzle, popularized by Demaine et al. (2014), asks for a way to wrap a wire around $n$ nails such that the picture hangs as long as fewer than $k$ nails are removed, but falls as soon as any $k$ are removed. Solutions correspond to words in the free group $F_n$. We give explicit, deterministic, polynomial-length constructions for two regimes: $2$-out-of-$n$ with word length at most $\tfrac{8}{3}n^{\log_2 6} - 4n^2$, and $(n-2)$-out-of-$n$ with word length $6n\log_2(n/2)$, both for $n$ a power of two. These improve on Wästlund's quasi-polynomial deterministic construction…
